proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Foe Slayer is a permanent always-on character milestone with no activation, no resource, and no reset cadence. The current ClassFeatureMechanics only supports the 'activation' family (activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect). That entire shape is inapplicable. A new family — something like 'passive_modifier' — is needed for class-level features that are simply always true once acquired.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The damage die of your Hunter's Mark is a d10 rather than a d6.

proposed_widenings.name: cross_unit_property_override effect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive family were added, no ClassFeatureEffect variant can express 'change the die size of a specific named spell's damage output'. This requires a cross-unit reference (pointing at hunter's_mark) with a property override (dieSize: 10 replaces dieSize: 6). Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect can represent this. The surface has no vocabulary for one unit overriding a property of another unit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The damage die of your Hunter's Mark is a d10 rather than a d6.

notes: Unit is a pure passive cross-unit die-size override. It modifies Hunter's Mark's damage die permanently at class level 20 — no action, no resource, no reset. Two gaps compound: (1) no 'passive' mechanics family exists for class features; (2) no cross-unit property reference exists in any ClassFeatureEffect variant. Both are required to encode this honestly. Forcing it into 'activation' with a fake effect would produce a misleading trace.
